business_summary: Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech(Group)Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells civil explosives. The company's products include expanded ammonium nitrate explosives, emulsion explosives, industrial electronic detonators, detonating cord detonators, plastic detonating cords, industrial detonating cords, and on-site mixed explosives; and industrial explosives, detonators, and cables. It also engages in the production and sale of chemical products, such as liquid ammonia, urea, nitric acid, ammonium nitrate, nitro compound fertilizer, melamine, UAN liquid fertilizer, and dilute ammonia water; fertilizers, and liquefied natural gas; and blasting services, hazardous materials transportation; transportation of dangerous goods and natural gas pipeline transportation business. In addition, the company provides engineering blasting services comprising drilling and transportation; and professional services, such as blasting scheme design, blasting engineering supervision, and planning and implementation of integrated mine blasting solutions, as well as security guard, leasing; business management, education, and commerce services.  The company also exports its products. The company serves coal mining, metal and non-metal mining, infrastructure construction, agriculture, and industrial production sectors. Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech(Group)Co.,Ltd was founded in 1958 and is based in Urumqi, China.
business_summary_ko: Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech(Group)Co.,Ltd는 자회사와 함께 토목 폭발물을 생산 및 판매합니다. 회사의 제품에는 팽창된 질산암모늄 폭약, 유제 폭약, 산업용 전자 뇌관, 기폭선 뇌관, 플라스틱 기폭선, 산업용 기폭선 및 현장 혼합 폭발물이 포함됩니다. 산업용 폭발물, 기폭 장치 및 케이블. 또한 액체 암모니아, 요소, 질산, 질산암모늄, 니트로 복합 비료, 멜라민, UAN 액체 비료 및 희석 암모니아수와 같은 화학 제품의 생산 및 판매에 종사합니다. 비료, 액화천연가스; 폭파 서비스, 위험 물질 운송; 위험물 운송 및 천연가스 파이프라인 운송업. 또한 회사는 시추 및 운송으로 구성된 엔지니어링 발파 서비스를 제공합니다. 발파 계획 설계, 발파 엔지니어링 감독, 통합 광산 발파 솔루션의 계획 및 구현, 경비원, 임대와 같은 전문 서비스; 경영, 교육, 상업 서비스를 제공합니다.  회사는 또한 제품을 수출합니다. 광고
